author: reek
body: The lane-distinctness axis for vector arithmetic and indexing. Every in-battery vector test builds its operands with vec-splat, which writes the same value to both lanes, so lane indexing is never exercised and an emitter that computed lane zero and broadcast it (addsd where addpd was meant is one prefix byte) gives the identical answer. The mask half of this axis is pinned by vec-mask-hazards; this bundle is the arithmetic and indexing half: extract must see two different lanes, each of the four operators must answer per lane, and the horizontal sum must add two different numbers.

author: reek
body: Distinct lanes are built by writing two doubles into a buffer, which is the only way to express one. Operands arrive as parameters so the temp rotation is not fixed by the shape of this file; every value is exactly representable so the prints are stable.
